description_en: Calls CreateBackupPlan to create a backup plan
kebab_example: aliyun cassandra create-backup-plan --cluster-id cds-bp11tjzh5000007b --data-center-id cn-hangzhou-g --backup-time 00:30Z --backup-period Monday --retention-period 5 --active true --client-token example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBackupPlan

parameters.description_en: The ID of the cluster to back up.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster to back up
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the data center of the cluster to back up.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the data center of the cluster to back up
parameters.name: data_center_id

parameters.description_en: The time when the backup starts each day. The time is in UTC and is indicated by the Z suffix.
parameters.description_zh: 每天开始备份的时间，UTC 通用标准时，以Z来标识。
parameters.help_en: The time when the backup starts each day. The time is in UTC and is indicated by the Z suffix
parameters.help_zh: 每天开始备份的时间，UTC 通用标准时，以Z来标识
parameters.name: backup_time

parameters.description_en: The backup cycle. Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.
parameters.help_en: The backup cycle. Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
parameters.name: backup_period

parameters.description_en: The number of days to retain the backup. Valid values: 1 to 7.
parameters.description_zh: 创建备份计划保留天数取值范围1-7天。
parameters.help_en: The number of days to retain the backup. Valid values: 1 to 7
parameters.help_zh: 创建备份计划保留天数取值范围1-7天
parameters.name: retention_period

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to activate the backup plan.
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to activate the backup plan
parameters.name: active
